# aap_eda_project (Data Source)

Get EDA project datasource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aap_eda_project" "example" {
  name = "My EDA Project"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) EDA Project ID. You must specify either the `id` or `name` field, but not both.
- `name` (String) EDA Project name. You must specify either the `id` or `name` field, but not both.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) EDA Project description.
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization ID for the EDA project.
- `scm_branch` (String) The SCM branch for the EDA project.
- `url` (String) The SCM URL for the EDA project.
